reason: I make every transfer myself, so my bank statement already is the record, and I can paste the screenshots into a sheet in five minutes a week. I'd maybe use the 30 free ones out of curiosity, but I won't pay $19 a month for that.
objection: If a contractor sends the same invoice twice, that's a people problem and I'll catch it when I check my transfers, not a software problem. Paying monthly to get told about it is one more subscription I'd cancel by month three.
would_change_my_mind: If it showed me on the first free batch that my site manager's receipts don't add up to what I wired, and it cost under $10 a month or a one-off fee per build.
